title: The ALMA early science view of FUor/EXor objects - IV. Misaligned outflows in the complex star-forming environment of V1647 Ori and McNeil's Nebula
question: What are the properties of the V1647 Ori circumstellar disc and the large-scale molecular environment and outflows traced by continuum and CO isotopologue emission?

data.sensitivity: Continuum 0.80 mJy/beam (3σ); 12CO and 13CO 45, C18O 36 mJy km/s/beam (3σ)

evidence.loc: 3.6 Dynamics of the V1647 Ori Environment
evidence.quote: adopt a $^{12}$CO to H$_{2}$ abundance ratio of 10$^{-4}$ and a $^{12}$CO to $^{13}$CO relative abundance of 62 (cite: Langer1993)

recipe.method: CASA reduction of pipeline-calibrated data, visibility-domain continuum subtraction, concatenation of the two ~1" epochs, cleaning; separate 0.2" continuum
immoments using pixels ≥3σ in blue (5.0-9.49), systemic (9.5-10.5), red (10.51-13.0 km/s) ranges
assumptions: systemic velocity ~10.0 km/s from C18O peak

recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit in CASA; inclination from aspect ratio of assumed circular disc; radius from FWHM and distance
Optically thin M = F d^2/(kappa B(T))
key_parameters: beta=1, kappa=0.023 cm2/g, T=20 K, d=414 pc
assumptions: gas to dust mass ratio of 100

recipe.method: Spectra in 2" and 20" diameter apertures centered on V1647 Ori, 0.25 km/s bins

assumptions: low inclination (17 deg) makes ages uncertain; straight-line travel

recipe.method: Sum over channels within 10" on PB-corrected 12CO and 13CO cubes

evidence.quote: a flux, inclination, position angle and centroid of 82.62 $\pm$ 8.26 mJy
results in a disc dust radius of $\sim$40 au
we estimate the disc dust mass of V1647 Ori to be $M_\mathrm{dust}$ = 427 M$_\mathrm{E}$

evidence.loc: 3.6 Dynamics of the V1647 Ori Environment
evidence.quote: has a dynamical age of $\sim$11,700 years
